'''Claudia''' is a painter from the Fisalia family found during the day at Egla Town, {{Location|Whisperwind Haven}}.
<!---==Location==
{{Map Embed|Whisperwind Haven|Claudia}}--->

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Claudia}}

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:Hmmm, this blue seems a bit too saturated...
:Cobalt blue and deep purple are the classical colors for deep sea, but is it truly the right choice for Fisalia?

==Dialogue==
;(First time interaction)
:'''Claudia:''' Nice to meet you, traveler from afar. I'm Claudia V. Fisalia, a traveling painter currently working on my landscape paintings.
:'''Claudia:''' I hope your time in Ragunna leaves you with beautiful memories.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Thank you.
:'''Claudia:''' Your eyes shine with a brilliance akin to the Sentinel's radiance... If you don't mind, would you accept this painting?
:'''{{DIcon}}:'''Oh, thank you. But maybe it's a bit too much...
:'''Claudia:''' No worries, it's just my personal creation and not something for sale.
:'''Claudia:''' I wish to paint the history within my heart and share it with those I feel are destined to connect with the Sentinel.
----
:'''Claudia:''' I'm curious, though it's a bit embarrassing to ask... What do you think of my artwork, {{Rover}}?
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' I'm curious about the towers in the painting.
::'''Claudia:''' Are you referring to the [[Thorncrown Rises]]? Once engraved with the history of Fisalia, they are now merely three abandoned structures on the sea ridge. 
::'''Claudia:''' In my childhood, I heard stories that the hidden main tower was the resting place for my family's first honors. 
::'''Claudia:''' What does that truly mean? Does the Fisalia family really have any honor left to speak now?
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' The use of color is truly distinctive.
::'''Claudia:''' Distinctive use of color, you say? They're actually my attempts to depict the legacy of the Fisalia family through color.
::'''Claudia:''' Why has the Fisalia family become like this? As someone not of the senior line, I can only speculate in this way now.
----
;(After {{Quest|Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides}})
{{Spoiler}}
:'''Claudia:''' I'm curious, though it's a bit embarrassing to ask... What do you think of my artwork, {{Rover}}?
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Is that the Thorncrown Rises in the painting?
::'''Claudia:''' Indeed. The Thorncrown Rises that bear the history of Fisalia.
::'''Claudia:''' Though they are now merely three abandoned structures on the sea ridge, they carry the Fisalias' true honor.
::'''Claudia:''' As a member of the Fisalia family, I've heard the truth from our head... I want to capture the glory we once had with my brush.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' The use of color is truly distinctive.
::'''Claudia:''' Distinctive use of color, you say? They're actually my attempts to depict the legacy of the Fisalia family through color.
::'''Claudia:''' Our history is marred and stained by the Dark Tide. Perhaps that's why these colors feel so fitting.

==Event Dialogue==
====[[Although Colors Have No Form]]====
:;'''Claudia''' These magical morph paintings... Are they really created with just brushes and paints?
:;'''Claudia''' If so, what was going through the creators' minds when they painted them?
:'''Claudia:''' That color... I want to learn more about it, no matter what... Thank you for the help.
{{Dialogue End}}
